machine.gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1, Unspecified Version)

method: VITE_TEST_HOOKS=1 build served on 127.0.0.1:5203 (gzip for text types, no cache). Fresh browser context per viewport (desktop DSF 2; phone DSF 3, isMobile, hasTouch). Download = bytes the server sent from navigation until 2 s of network silence. States: first load, then each module tab (and its cinematic sub-state while a shot plays). Medium preset forced after the download measurement. Alive: two canvas-only screenshots 5 s apart, 3x3 grid, a region counts when >= 0.25% of its pixels change by > 12/255. Performance: 4 s sample per state; GPU time from EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 around each requestAnimationFrame dispatch; draw calls and triangles counted at the WebGL call level (all passes), max over the sample.

inspectableObjectsReach.note: Mouse, keyboard list and text mode checked at 1440x900, touch at 390x844, in every exploration state

exempt.reason: A line, not an object: the channel is 1.9 m wide and 0.3 m deep along a 220 m course (z -60 to 160 m), and it follows the ground, so its bounding box measures the terrain it crosses.
A stratum (a layer of ground), not an object: x 0 to 33.3 m by z 0 to 100 m, sward 0.3 m deep. The clickable patch by the stream is one part of it.
A stratum (a layer of ground), not an object: x 66.7 to 100 m by z 0 to 100 m, sward 0.3 m deep. The clickable patch on the rise is one part of it.
A face along a curving bank: a 3 m run of the stream bank with a 0.4 m soil profile. It follows the stream bend, so its bounding box also measures the curve (about 1.5 m across).
A line: 110 m long (x -6 to 104 m), shrubs 2.9 m tall and 3.1 m deep (own-work hedge-shrub LOD0). It follows the ground, so its bounding box also measures the slope it crosses.
An area: a woodland block about 150 m by 40 m, trees up to 15.9 m tall (own-work tree-tall LOD0), on rising ground.
A line: 128 m long (x -14 to 114 m), 1.1 m high and 0.55 m wide. It follows the ground, so its bounding box also measures the slope it crosses.
A motion of the sward, not an object: it moves the 100 m x 100 m meadow and the long grass at its margins.
